raw_response: {"diagnosis":"raw_transactions has 4835 rows but only 4814 distinct txn_ids, and the ids run contiguously from 900001 to 904814. So about 21 rows are re-delivered duplicates of the same transaction, and silver_transactions has no dedup step. Fix: keep one row per txn_id, the latest delivery (highest ingest_ts, then batch_id), and apply the POSTED filter after that, so a later status change still wins.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.72,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT * FROM raw_transactions QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts DESC, batch_id DESC, txn_ts DESC, amount DESC) = 1) d WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
